description:
The Modrinth App is a unique, open source Minecraft launcher that allows you to play your favorite mods, and keep them up to date, all in one neat little package.


Changed
- The server panel will no longer be locked while individual content is being installed when using the Browse content button.
- Better stability when content is being installed
- Modrinth Hosting: The server panel will no longer be locked while individual content is being installed when using the Browse content button.
- Modrinth Hosting: Better stability when content is being installed

Fixed
- Fixed issue when trying to upgrade a medal server from the manage servers page.
- Modrinth Hosting: Fixed issue when trying to upgrade a medal server from the manage servers page.
